description: The blow, and not the word

participation.context: Wrote the blow, struck a line, and left the foot of the leaf empty.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You set down one blow and struck the explanation. You did not start the Prince. The next word is not on the leaf.

title: Wrote the blow and stopped

description: Like a title, and one leaf

participation.context: Named the day off, and did not write on.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Not in the house. The name is his, and it waited.
participation.name: Will Kemp

story.body: You said the name had the day off. You did not add to the leaf. You stopped.

title: Said the name had the day off
